## 4.89  
(a) Note that $\int_2^{\infty} \frac{1}{\beta} e^{-y/\beta} dy = e^{-2/\beta}=0.0821 \Rightarrow \beta = 0.8$  
(b) $P(Y \le 1.7) = 1 - e^{-1.7/0.8} = 0.5075$

## 4.93  
Let $Y$ be the time between fatal airplane accidents. So $Y \sim \text{Exponential}(\beta=44)$.  
(a) $P(Y \le 31) = \int_0^{31}\frac{1}{44}e^{-y/44}=1 - e^{-31/44} = 0.5057$  
(b) $V(Y) = \beta^2 = 44^2 = 1936$

## 4.109  
$Y \sim \text{Gamma}(\alpha=3,\ \beta=2)$, $L = 30Y + 2Y^2$  
$E(L) = 30E(Y)+2E(Y^2)=30(6)+2(12+6^2)=276$  
$V(L) = E(L^2)-[E(L)]^2=E(900Y^2 + 120Y^3 + 4Y^4) - 276^2.$
$E(Y^3) = \int+0^{\infty}\frac{y^5}{16}e^{-y/2} = 480$ and $E(Y^4) = \int+0^{\infty}\frac{y^6}{16}e^{-y/2} = 5760$
Thus, $V(Y) = 900(48)+120(480)+4(5760)-276^2=47664$

$Y \sim \text{Gamma}(\alpha=4,\ \beta=2)$
(a) $k = 1/(\Gamma(4)2^4) = 1/96$
(b) $Y \sim \chi^2$ with $\nu = 2\alpha = 8$ degrees of freedom
(c) $E(Y) = \alpha\beta = 4(2) = 8$, $V(Y) = \alpha\beta^2 =4(2^2)= 16$

## 4.104
$Y \sim \text{Exponential}(\beta=100)$, $P(Y>200)=e^{-2}$ Let the random variable $X$ be the number of components that operate in the equipment for more than 200 hours. Then
$X \sim \text{Binomial}(n=3, p=e^{-2})$, $P(X\ge2)=P(X=2)+P(X=3)=3(e^{-2})^2(1 - e^{-2}) + (e^{-2})^3=0.05$
